findings.issue: record_gap deep-copies the session, so assigning previous['status'] afterward changes the detached ledger, leaving the saved exhausted session PENDING. Re-entering BUDGET_STOP then tries to add an overlapping crash gap instead of returning the stopped state.

Recovery still runs after budget/audio checks and is not saved before the backfill rejection. Retrying the crashed interval raises ValueError with the durable reservation still PENDING, failing issue #219's same-start acceptance criterion.

The new regression only checks returned gap reasons and uses a shared /tmp WAV. It neither checks the persisted FAILED ledger nor covers same-start rejection or wall-clock exhaustion; the detached-ledger defect therefore passes.

summary: Fixed two crash-recovery defects and strengthened the regression test: pending reservations are durably saved as FAILED with SESSION_CRASH before budget exits or rejected retries, while stopped sessions remain stopped and retain earlier gaps. All 41 related Python tests, 69 Web tests and the CLI self-check pass; regression tests first failed with three assertions and two overlap errors. Full npm run check remains red in 10 groups on Windows (Web 813/816), while the Next.js production build passes; four platform failures also reproduce from the original reviewed head.
